sources.disposition: Garden observer checks expected/actual populations and identities before children and GPU membership, with no retained scene mutation. Distance and angle comparisons use >epsilon; nonfinite native transforms would make comparisons unordered and can escape this particular check. This is conditional evidence-limit support for the existing native graphics owner question, not proof normal generated plants become invalid. Child counts are bounded by actual query iteration; each mesh/texture readiness miss returns Err.

Closed LOD enum maps all production variants. Select indexes the capture view via driver invariant, records original range before override, uses fixed finite0/MAX margins, and restores/removes original when override ends. Counts derive from query populations. Evidence bookkeeping marks recorded before fallible filesystem write and then expects; diagnostic write failure is terminal rather than a recoverable partial production-state contract. No new arithmetic result admission issue.

Shared readiness mutex protects replacement of mesh and image sets and membership observation. Both sets replaced under one lock, so reader cannot observe inter-set partial replacement. No quantity arithmetic/index cast; poisoned-lock expect is native synchronization failure, not a newly observed normal GPU readiness error. Membership uses actual IDs and all supplied textures.

Interior furniture visibility derives owner map from actual camera/building native transform distances; missing owner defaults hidden except explicit exhibition resource. Nonfinite distance compares false and hides rather than publishes derived transform. Each changed visibility assignment is final infallible enum mutation; no numerical retained state produced. Graphic transform admission remains outside registered9-63, so no blanket scene validity claim.
